name: Bimhal
title: Descendant of Asher
summary: Bimhal is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles as one of the sons of Japhlet, a descendant of the tribe of Asher. He is only named in a genealogy and has no further narrative role in the Bible. His significance lies in his place within the tribal history of Asher.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Genealogy of Asher
keyEvents.description: Bimhal is listed as one of the three sons of Japhlet in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher.

keyEvents.title: Descendants of Asher Who Were Skilled Warriors
keyEvents.description: The descendants of Asher, including Bimhal's lineage, are described as family heads, skilled warriors and leaders, numbering 26,000 men fit for battle.

keyEvents.title: Japhlet's Sons in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Bimhal is mentioned along with his brothers Paseah and Ashvath as the sons of Japhlet, part of the broader record of the tribes of Israel.

keyEvents.title: The Inheritance of the Tribe of Asher
keyEvents.description: As part of the tribe of Asher, Bimhal belonged to a people who received Jacob's blessing and were given land in the Promised Land.
